zh: 每次点击沿一条有向边走一步，求最少点击次数就是有向图上的无权最短路问题。
用邻接表模拟 get_links（只存出边），从 start 做 BFS，第一次到达 target 时所在的层数就是答案；start 与 target 相同时答案为 0，BFS 结束仍未到达则输出 -1。
读入所有边，把页面名映射成整数编号（区分大小写，名字可以含非英文字符），建立出边表；用队列做 BFS 并标记已访问，自环和重复链接不会让节点重复入队；节点出队时若是 target 就输出它的距离。
en: Each click follows one directed edge, so the fewest clicks is an unweighted shortest path on a directed graph.

Simulate get_links with an adjacency list of outgoing edges only and run BFS from start; the level at which target is first reached is the answer; it is 0 when start equals target, and -1 if BFS ends without reaching target.

Read all edges, map page names to integer ids (case-sensitive, names may contain non-English characters) and build the outgoing edge lists; run BFS with a queue and visited marks so self-loops and duplicate links never enqueue a node twice; when target is dequeued, print its distance.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Build an outgoing-edge table to simulate get_links, then run BFS from start and return the level at which target is first found.

## Correctness

Each edge on a path corresponds to one click, and BFS expands level by level in order of distance, so the distance at which a node is first reached is the shortest. Traversing only outgoing edges never turns a one-way link into a reverse link, and the visited marks keep self-loops from being repeated.

## Complexity

O(V+m) time and O(V+m) space, plus storage for the page names.
